response.sql: WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), average_spend AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS amount FROM budget_totals) SELECT AVG(bt.total_cost) AS average_total, SUM(bt.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(bt.total_cost - a.amount) AS average_excess FROM budget_totals AS bt CROSS JOIN average_spend AS a WHERE bt.total_cost > a.amount;
